survey: Sci-fi control console. A light-grey box body stands flat on a riveted metal floor; its base edge meets the floor along the whole front and right side. The top is a dark-grey panel sloping toward the viewer, set into the white casing, with a raised grey rail running along the back edge. On the panel: two round dials (white and green), each with a needle on a centre pivot; eight round push buttons in two staggered rows of four (red/yellow), each seated in a dark bezel; and on the right a red-knobbed lever whose shaft rises from a collar sitting in a slotted housing, so it can move along the slot. The front face has one inset drawer with a single centred pull handle. The camera sees the front and right side faces from slightly above; the parts are consistent with that view.
